{{translated title}} ---- (Japanese: '''{{j|ポケモンカードゲームやろうぜ～っ！　サン{{ruby|＆|アンド}}ムーン{{ruby|編|へん}}}}''' ''Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game! Sun & Moon Arc'') is a {{pkmn|manga}} by [[Ryū Matsushima]] based on the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]]. It was serialized in the ''[[CoroCoro|CoroCoro Ichiban!]]'' magazine from the January 2017 issue (released on November 21, 2016) to the January 2020 issue (released on November 21, 2019). It is the sequel of [[Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game XY!]] and is followed by [[Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game! Sword & Shield Arc]]. It tells the story of the brothers [[Shin Kyougi|Shin]] and [[Makoto Kyougi]]. The manga was collected into four volumes that are simply referred to as (Japanese: '''{{j|ポケモンカードゲームやろうぜ～っ！}}''' ''Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game!''). Instead of being labeled numerically, they are individually titled (Japanese: '''{{j|ソルガレオ{{ruby|Ｇ|ジー}}{{ruby|Ｘ|エックス}}ルナアーラ{{ruby|Ｇ|ジー}}{{ruby|Ｘ|エックス}}{{ruby|激|げき}}{{ruby|突|とつ}}！{{ruby|編|へん}}}}''' ''SolgaleoGX LunalaGX Clash! Arc''), (Japanese: '''{{j|ウルトラビースト{{ruby|襲|しゅう}}{{ruby|来|らい}}！{{ruby|編|へん}}}}''' ''Ultra Beast Invasion! Arc''), (Japanese: '''{{j|{{ruby|Ｇ|ジー}}{{ruby|Ｘ|エックス}}スタートデッキ{{ruby|編|へん}}}}''' ''GX Start Deck Arc''), and (Japanese: '''{{j|タッグチーム{{ruby|Ｇ|ジー}}{{ruby|Ｘ|エックス}}{{ruby|編|へん}}}}''' ''Tag Team GX Arc'').
